automotive-ev-battery.title: Europe misses out on billion-euro battery cell profits
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Europe's dependence on Asian battery cell manufacturers has deepened significantly, with 77 percent of EV batteries now produced in Asia compared to 70 percent in 2024. The trend highlights Europe's growing reliance on foreign suppliers, particularly Chinese companies like CATL, even for cells produced within European borders.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Sono Motors declares insolvency
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Sono Motors GmbH has ceased operations and initiated insolvency proceedings effective July 31, concluding the Munich-based company's decade-long pursuit of solar-powered vehicle technology with the Sion model. The company's solar brand, intellectual property, and power electronics are now for sale.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Philippines launches €850m incentive programme for EV manufacturing
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Philippines has introduced a substantial incentive program worth approximately €852 million designed to attract electric vehicle manufacturing to the country. The scheme offers investment and production incentives for domestically built electric passenger and commercial vehicles and their components.

automotive-ev-battery.title: EVgo and Brixmor to add more than 500 fast charging stalls in the US
automotive-ev-battery.summary: EVgo and Brixmor Property Group are expanding their partnership by deploying more than 500 additional DC fast charging stations across shopping centers throughout the United States. The expansion will bring EVgo chargers to at least 90 Brixmor properties, covering more than a quarter of the real estate portfolio.

automotive-ev-battery.title: KiBa-Pro brings AI to battery cell manufacturing
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The KiBa-Pro joint project, led by EAS Batteries and launched in July 2026, explores how data and artificial intelligence can transform battery cell production processes. The initiative addresses optimization and efficiency improvements in the manufacturing sector.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Drivalia secures EIB loan for procurement of 2,900 BEVs
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Drivalia has obtained €48 million in financing from the European Investment Bank to procure 2,900 battery electric vehicles for corporate customers. The car leasing and mobility provider plans to deploy the emission-free vehicles across Italy and Finland.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Audi further strips A2 E-Tron of its camouflage
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Audi has revealed additional technical specifications and design details for the all-electric A2 e-tron ahead of its fall world premiere. New photographs show the vehicle with significantly reduced camouflage, disclosing information regarding battery capacity, drivetrain configuration, efficiency metrics, and expected range.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Hyundai Kona Electric now qualifies for full UK Electric Car Grant
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Hyundai Kona Electric has been upgraded to qualify for the full £3,750 UK Electric Car Grant incentive following a review of the model's environmental supply chain credentials. The decision reflects the vehicle's improved environmental performance classification.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Nice opens former Mobilize Share charging network to public
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Nice Côte d'Azur metropolitan region has taken control of 86 charging stations previously operated exclusively by Renault's Mobilize car-sharing subsidiary and converted them into a public charging network. The repurposing follows Mobilize's discontinuation of its service at the end of June 2026 as part of organizational restructuring.

automotive-ev-battery.title: NIO's Sales Rise 71% in July
automotive-ev-battery.summary: NIO recorded 35,934 vehicle deliveries in July 2026, representing a 71 percent increase compared to July 2025 when the company achieved 21,017 deliveries. The company has delivered 227,057 vehicles across the first six months of 2026.

science-space.title: NASA's PUNCH Sharpens Solar Storm Forecasting in First Test
science-space.summary: NASA's PUNCH mission has demonstrated a significant breakthrough in solar storm prediction, successfully forecasting the near-Earth arrival of a solar eruption to within 30 minutes using continuous imagery. This proof-of-concept achievement, presented at the Committee on Space Research Scientific Meeting, could substantially improve our ability to predict dangerous space weather events.

science-space.title: NASA Provides Updates on Moon Base Cargo Landers, Tech Demonstrations
science-space.summary: NASA is advancing lunar infrastructure development through partnerships with commercial aerospace firms including Blue Origin, Firefly Aerospace, Intuitive Machines, and Voyager Lunar Systems, with cargo landers targeted for delivery by 2028. These milestones represent critical progress toward establishing a resilient outpost near the Moon's South Pole for scientific research and eventual human operations.

science-space.title: 'Significant areas of Mars may have once been covered by water': Scientists find hidden clue in Spirit rover data
science-space.summary: A new analysis of archival data from NASA's Spirit rover has revealed previously overlooked traces of crystalline hematite and altered magnetite on Mars, providing additional evidence that liquid water once played a substantial role in shaping the Red Planet's surface. This discovery underscores the importance of revisiting legacy planetary science data with modern analytical techniques.

science-space.title: SpaceX wants to launch next Starship this month (and catch it, too), Elon Musk says in 1st earnings call since historic IPO
science-space.summary: SpaceX plans to execute significant milestones during its next Starship megarocket test flight, tentatively scheduled for late August, including an attempt to catch the returning booster. This announcement comes during Elon Musk's first earnings call since the company's recent initial public offering.

science-space.title: 'A very busy mission': SpaceX on track to launch 4 astronauts to the ISS on Sept. 12
science-space.summary: NASA and SpaceX officials have confirmed preparations for the Crew-13 mission, which is scheduled to launch four astronauts to the International Space Station on September 12, 2026. The crew members and agency representatives provided a media update detailing their readiness for the upcoming crewed spaceflight.

science-space.title: NASA Will Attempt to Observe Rocket Part's Lunar Impact
science-space.summary: NASA and SpaceX are tracking a spent Falcon 9 upper stage expected to impact the Moon on August 5 near the Einstein and Bell craters, deploying ground-based telescopes and space-based assets to collect scientific data from the event. The impact poses no threat to Earth and represents an opportunity to gather valuable lunar surface information.

science-space.title: Watch SpaceX launch 3 giant BlueBird direct-to-cell satellites early on Aug. 5
science-space.summary: SpaceX is scheduled to launch three of AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird direct-to-cell satellites on the morning of August 5, marking another milestone in the development of satellite-based cellular connectivity. The launch will be available for live viewing.

science-space.title: SpaceX launches Starlink satellites on 90th Falcon 9 flight of the year
science-space.summary: SpaceX completed its 90th Falcon 9 launch of 2026 on August 4, deploying 24 additional Starlink internet satellites to low Earth orbit. The continued cadence of launches demonstrates the company's sustained commitment to expanding its global broadband constellation.

science-space.title: When a total solar eclipse darkens the sky on Aug. 12, these citizen scientists will be watching
science-space.summary: A citizen scientist initiative is preparing to engage the public in observations and data collection during a total solar eclipse scheduled for August 12, 2026, bringing broader participation to scientific research. The program aims to enhance eclipse science through crowdsourced observations.

science-space.title: Roman Space Telescope Plaque Install
science-space.summary: Technicians have installed a commemorative plaque on NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope honoring the legacy of Dr. Nancy Grace Roman, the agency's first chief astronomer and architect of its modern science program. The plaque also features a memory card containing over 1.3 million digital names.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Tehran-Oman talks on Hormuz 'positive'; ship hit in Red Sea
world-news.summary: Iran reports that diplomatic talks with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are progressing positively, with US officials indicating a potential agreement may be achievable soon. The development follows ongoing regional tensions, including a ship strike in the Red Sea, with implications for global energy markets and maritime security.

world-news.title: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
world-news.summary: US State Department officials announced progress in talks aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping, with both Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirming that negotiations have advanced toward resuming oil shipments. The development signals potential de-escalation of regional tensions affecting global energy markets.

world-news.title: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
world-news.summary: A video depicts a Russian drone pursuing a terrified Ukrainian civilian, with Kyiv characterizing the incident as a potential war crime under international humanitarian law. The attack underscores escalating violations in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.

world-news.title: One killed, five injured in Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
world-news.summary: Russian forces conducted a ballistic missile strike on Ukraine's capital, resulting in one death and five injuries as part of the continued military campaign. The attack follows a series of cross-border strikes that have killed dozens of civilians and military personnel throughout the week.

world-news.title: US revokes visa of Brazilian ambassador amid deepening diplomatic spat
world-news.summary: The United States has revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador, marking an escalation in bilateral diplomatic tensions between the two nations. Officials clarified that the action does not necessarily imply the ambassador's expulsion from US territory.

world-news.title: Projectile sinks Indian-flagged ship off Yemen coast
world-news.summary: An Indian-flagged vessel was struck by a projectile off the Yemeni coast, though all 14 crew members were safely rescued by maritime authorities. The incident reflects ongoing maritime security concerns in the Red Sea region amid regional conflicts.

world-news.title: EU commends Spain's 'swift response' to Ceuta migrant crisis
world-news.summary: Spain reported successfully returning approximately 70,000 of 72,000 migrants who entered the North African enclave of Ceuta illegally to Morocco, earning EU praise for its rapid response. The mass migration event highlighted ongoing tensions surrounding irregular migration patterns in the Mediterranean region.

world-news.title: Ukraine hits more Wildberries sites as strike kills five in Moscow region
world-news.summary: Ukrainian forces conducted strikes against facilities operated by Russia's largest online retailer, killing five people in the Moscow region while also targeting sites in St. Petersburg and Tver. The attacks represent continued Ukrainian military operations targeting Russian civilian and commercial infrastructure.

world-news.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
world-news.summary: A mass funeral was held for 112 Palestinians from two extended families whose bodies were recently recovered from rubble in Gaza City following a 2023 Israeli military strike. The burial marks a grim milestone in the long-running Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

world-news.title: How the far right weaponised the Ceuta crisis
world-news.summary: Far-right political movements capitalized on the Ceuta migrant crisis, which saw over 72 deaths during the crossing attempt, to advance xenophobic narratives and influence European political discourse. The incident underscores how migration tragedies become politicized across the continent.

finance-markets.title: US stocks jump after Bessent says deal to reopen Hormuz is imminent
finance-markets.summary: The S&P 500 reached a record high following announcements that Iranian and Omani negotiators have agreed on a temporary shipping arrangement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The breakthrough eased geopolitical tensions and energy supply concerns that had weighed on markets.

finance-markets.title: Musk's SpaceX unnerves investors with lavish AI spending plans
finance-markets.summary: Despite SpaceX reporting nearly doubled quarterly revenues, investor concerns over the company's aggressive artificial intelligence expenditure plans have prompted share declines. The divergence between strong operational performance and investor apprehension reflects broader market uncertainty around AI investment returns.

finance-markets.title: Trump administration refunds $100bn in 'liberation day' tariffs
finance-markets.summary: The Trump administration has refunded approximately $100 billion in tariffs that were struck down by the Supreme Court in what officials termed a 'liberation day' action. The repayment represents roughly 60% of the levies and signals a significant shift in trade policy implementation.

finance-markets.title: Toyota plans $6.3bn buyback as weak yen boosts outlook
finance-markets.summary: Toyota, the world's largest carmaker, announced a $6.3 billion share buyback program capitalizing on improved financial outlook driven by currency weakness. The company expects to sell over 5 million hybrid electric vehicles this year, reflecting strong demand for alternative powertrains.

finance-markets.title: Whale Rock Sank 22% as AI Selloff Crippled Hedge Fund Returns
finance-markets.summary: Whale Rock Capital Management's flagship hedge fund experienced a 21.7% decline in July as the broader artificial intelligence sector selloff eroded returns, eliminating approximately half of the fund's year-to-date gains. The performance reflects heightened volatility and repricing across technology and AI-focused investments.

finance-markets.title: SpaceX exceeds revenue estimates in first earnings report since IPO
finance-markets.summary: SpaceX's inaugural post-IPO quarterly earnings report showed revenues surpassing Wall Street expectations, reflecting strong performance across its rocket, satellite, and artificial intelligence operations. The blockbuster IPO in June positioned Elon Musk's space and technology conglomerate as a major market player.

finance-markets.title: Gold Holds Steady as Progress on Hormuz Trims Rate-Hike Bets
finance-markets.summary: Gold prices remained stable in narrow trading ranges as prospective agreements to reopen the Strait of Hormuz reduced inflation concerns and lowered expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate increases. The development signals potential moderation in monetary policy pressures.

finance-markets.title: US cannot 'stay isolated' from Chinese EV competition, warns Lucid CEO
finance-markets.summary: Lucid's new chief executive cautioned that the United States cannot remain insulated from intensifying Chinese electric vehicle competition and announced a $1.4 billion cost-cutting initiative. The carmaker's leadership predicts an industry consolidation phase as competitive pressures mount.

finance-markets.title: Booking Holdings Keeps Full-Year Outlook on Resilient Travel
finance-markets.summary: Booking Holdings maintained its full-year guidance for gross bookings and revenue despite headwinds from Middle East conflict affecting flight capacity and pricing. The travel services company's confidence reflects sustained consumer demand for travel experiences globally.

finance-markets.title: China's Quant Curbs Sap Volatility and Turnover: Equity Insight
finance-markets.summary: China's regulatory crackdown on quantitative trading strategies has successfully reduced stock market volatility but simultaneously depressed trading turnover and liquidity. The policy demonstrates the tradeoff between volatility management and market activity levels.

tech-ai.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
tech-ai.summary: SpaceX reported doubled revenue compared to the previous year, driven primarily by major compute provision deals with Anthropic and Google, alongside continued Starlink expansion. The earnings represent the company's financial performance since its public market debut in June.

tech-ai.title: SpaceX made more revenue as an AI company than a space company
tech-ai.summary: SpaceX's artificial intelligence division generated $2.6 billion in revenue, more than tripling year-over-year, primarily through compute provision agreements with Anthropic and Google, surpassing traditional space operations revenue. The AI division, despite its revenue growth, reported a $1.5 billion operating loss for the quarter.

tech-ai.title: AMD's data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
tech-ai.summary: AMD's data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year to $6.7 billion in its latest earnings report, driven by robust demand for AI infrastructure capacity, with CEO Lisa Su forecasting continued growth exceeding 100 percent in 2027. The company's gaming segment revenue declined 31 percent during the same period.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic announced a $10 billion partnership with AI cloud startup Volta as part of its ongoing strategy to secure cloud infrastructure partnerships for supporting its artificial intelligence operations. The deal underscores the intensifying competition among AI companies to secure dedicated computational resources.

tech-ai.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
tech-ai.summary: A SaferAI report reveals that open-weight AI models, exemplified by Z.ai's GLM-5.2, are approaching frontier capabilities while lacking essential safety mitigations, raising concerns about governance gaps. The findings highlight a critical disparity between model performance advancement and safety protocol development in the open-source AI ecosystem.

tech-ai.title: Nvidia doesn't mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it's already showing progress
tech-ai.summary: The Open Secure AI Alliance, spearheaded by Nvidia and comprising over 120 companies, has already developed initial proposals for defending against AI agent threats one week after its formation. The initiative demonstrates rapid industry mobilization toward establishing AI security standards and governance frameworks.

tech-ai.title: Lucid's turnaround plan hinges on $1.4B in cash savings, robotaxis
tech-ai.summary: Lucid's new CEO Silvio Napoli outlined four critical priorities for the company's turnaround, including successful midsize EV launch, Saudi Arabia factory completion, expense reduction targeting $1.4 billion in savings, and robotaxi development. The strategic plan addresses both immediate operational challenges and long-term autonomous vehicle ambitions.

tech-ai.title: Android app developers may be unwittingly sharing their users' location data with advertisers
tech-ai.summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation's research reveals that Android app developers may inadvertently enable location data collection by advertisers through third-party code embedded within their applications, even when users grant location permissions for primary functionality. The findings highlight significant privacy vulnerabilities in the mobile app ecosystem.

tech-ai.title: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
tech-ai.summary: Signal has expanded its multi-device linking capabilities to support additional smartphones alongside existing support for computers and tablets, enabling users to synchronize messages across multiple phone numbers. The update includes options for end-to-end encrypted message transfer to newly linked devices, enhancing security for shared or compromised equipment scenarios.

tech-ai.title: EA is now a private company
tech-ai.summary: Electronic Arts officially completed its transition to private ownership under a $55 billion leveraged buyout led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners, with the PIF holding 93.4 percent ownership. The transaction, financed with $20 billion in debt, represents the largest leveraged buyout on record and signals potential significant operational changes.

health-biotech.title: Ebola kills 1,700 in eastern Congo as the fastest-growing outbreak surges
health-biotech.summary: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has claimed over 1,700 lives and has become the fastest-growing outbreak of the disease on record. This public health crisis represents a significant global health emergency requiring immediate international attention and response.

health-biotech.title: Novo vs. Lilly: Q2's cardiometabolic grudge match
health-biotech.summary: Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly continue to dominate the obesity medicine market as the duopoly competes for leadership in what is emerging as the largest pharmaceutical category in history. The competitive dynamics between these two companies are reshaping the cardiometabolic treatment landscape.

health-biotech.title: Merck plans trial of sac-TMT combo with Keytruda in lung cancer
health-biotech.summary: Merck announced plans to conduct a clinical trial testing its experimental antibody-drug conjugate sac-TMT in combination with its blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda for lung cancer treatment. This represents a significant strategic initiative to expand Merck's oncology pipeline and improve upon existing therapies.

health-biotech.title: Otsuka succeeds with kidney drug; BioNTech downgrades revenue projection
health-biotech.summary: Otsuka announced positive Phase 3 data for Voyxact, which met a key secondary endpoint in treating patients with IgA nephropathy, while BioNTech downgraded its revenue projections. These developments signal mixed progress in the biotech sector with significant implications for respective pipelines.

health-biotech.title: Startup promising to scale custom CRISPR therapies abruptly scraps plans
health-biotech.summary: A CRISPR therapy startup has abandoned its plans to scale custom gene editing treatments amid FDA regulatory challenges that smaller companies struggle to meet despite the agency's stated flexibility. This development highlights the regulatory and financial barriers facing innovation in personalized gene therapy.

health-biotech.title: Eli Lilly expands early access program for retatrutide obesity drug
health-biotech.summary: Eli Lilly confirmed that it will expand patient eligibility for early access to retatrutide, its investigational obesity treatment, allowing more patients to apply before FDA approval. This move reflects Lilly's commitment to increasing access to its promising cardiometabolic candidates.

health-biotech.title: Analysis questions warrant for latest orphan drug exemptions under federal law
health-biotech.summary: A new analysis challenges the justification for certain orphan drug exemptions from Medicare pricing negotiations under current federal law. The findings raise concerns about whether the regulatory provisions adequately serve their intended purpose of supporting rare disease treatments.

health-biotech.title: Amgen culls early-stage obesity candidate, makes pipeline updates
health-biotech.summary: Amgen discontinued its secretive Phase 1 obesity candidate AMG-513, with the company providing limited details on the rationale behind the decision. This move reflects the highly competitive obesity market landscape where companies must carefully prioritize their pipeline investments.

health-biotech.title: U.K. regulator weighs in on whether AI scribes qualify as medical devices
health-biotech.summary: The U.K. regulatory authority is examining the classification of AI scribing tools that use artificial intelligence to document clinical conversations as medical devices. This regulatory determination has significant implications for the growing ambient scribe market and device oversight frameworks.

health-biotech.title: Hinge Health to acquire Cylinder Health for $105M to expand into digestive care
health-biotech.summary: Virtual physical therapy company Hinge Health announced a $105 million cash acquisition of digestive health startup Cylinder Health, marking its expansion into additional chronic condition categories. The deal reflects Hinge Health's strategy to broaden its digital health platform across multiple therapeutic areas.

crypto-web3.title: Wells Fargo joins JPMorgan and Citi in the race to tokenize Wall Street's settlement rails
crypto-web3.summary: Wells Fargo has entered the tokenization race by launching payments on its proprietary blockchain, joining major competitors JPMorgan and Citi in modernizing Wall Street's settlement infrastructure. The bank's tokenized payments will route automatically through existing client interfaces, signaling institutional adoption of blockchain-based financial rails.

crypto-web3.title: Samsung is poised to become a dominant stablecoin distributor, analysts say
crypto-web3.summary: Samsung plans to transform its 800 million Galaxy phones into digital asset wallets and blockchain payment platforms, positioning itself as a major stablecoin distributor. The initiative represents a significant push into crypto infrastructure and mainstream adoption of blockchain-based payments.

crypto-web3.title: Dinari brings tokenized U.S. stocks to American investors as equity race heats up
crypto-web3.summary: Dinari has expanded access to tokenized U.S. stocks for American investors through self-custody wallets using USDC, intensifying competition in the blockchain-based equities space. The platform's custodial tokenization model brings institutional-grade equity infrastructure to retail crypto participants.

crypto-web3.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
crypto-web3.summary: Despite market concerns over the new Open USD stablecoin, major financial institutions including Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard have affirmed their continued support for USDC. The statements suggest Open USD will operate as an additional payments infrastructure rather than displacing existing stablecoin standards.

crypto-web3.title: BitGo moves $7.4 billion Wrapped Bitcoins to Chainlink CCIP in latest LayerZero exodus
crypto-web3.summary: BitGo has transferred $7.4 billion in Wrapped Bitcoin to Chainlink's cross-chain interoperability protocol, continuing a broader migration away from LayerZero. The move brings total value migrated from LayerZero to approximately $15 billion, signaling a significant shift in cross-chain infrastructure preferences.

crypto-web3.title: Polymarket targets $20 billion valuation as competition heats up in prediction market sector
crypto-web3.summary: The blockchain-based prediction markets platform Polymarket is seeking a $20 billion valuation in its latest funding round, reflecting growing investor appetite for decentralized prediction infrastructure. The move comes amid intensifying competition in the prediction markets sector.

crypto-web3.title: Clarity Act sits idle over Trump ethics question as Warren asks SEC to investigate him
crypto-web3.summary: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal have requested SEC investigation into President Trump's memecoin, creating complications for the stalled Clarity Act crypto regulation bill. The ethics concerns threaten to further delay legislative progress on comprehensive digital asset frameworks.

crypto-web3.title: Ethereum researchers propose burning validator rewards to cap staking at 50%
crypto-web3.summary: Ethereum researchers have introduced EIP-8361, which would gradually burn an increasing share of validator rewards as the staking ratio rises, aiming to maintain staking participation below 50%. The proposal addresses concerns about excessive capital concentration in Ethereum's proof-of-stake mechanism.

crypto-web3.title: SpaceX tops Wall Street revenue forecast, posts $540 million loss on bitcoin holdings
crypto-web3.summary: SpaceX exceeded Wall Street revenue expectations in its first earnings report as a public company while recording a $540 million unrealized loss on bitcoin holdings. The results highlight the impact of recent cryptocurrency price volatility on corporate balance sheets ahead of a major insider share unlock.

crypto-web3.title: Cloudflare kicks off stablecoin wallet rollout for AI agents to pay for APIs and online content
crypto-web3.summary: Cloudflare has launched its stablecoin wallet rollout enabling AI agents to pay for APIs and online services, with users able to claim wallet handles ahead of funding features. The initiative positions blockchain-based payments as infrastructure for machine-to-machine transactions in the emerging AI economy.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing at least 570 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software products, nearly triple the number patched in the previous month's record release. The company attributed the surge in vulnerability discoveries to artificial intelligence-assisted security research.

cybersecurity.title: Keyv-Linked npm Worm Poisons Hundreds of Packages, Plants Claude Code and VS Code Hooks
cybersecurity.summary: A credential-stealing worm originating from keyv@6.0.0 compromised at least 353 poisoned package versions across 79 names in the npm registry, with estimates suggesting over 868 packages affected across 353 names. The malware propagated across multiple organizations and installed malicious hooks in development tools.

cybersecurity.title: CISA Adds Exploited N-able N-central Flaw to KEV After Customer Compromises
cybersecurity.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a high-severity N-able N-central vulnerability (CVE-2026-18577, CVSS 8.2) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following confirmed active exploitation and customer compromises in the wild. The flaw represents incomplete patching of an earlier vulnerability and allows unauthorized access.

cybersecurity.title: Greatness PhaaS Adds Device Code Phishing to Bypass MFA and Steal Tokens
cybersecurity.summary: The Greatness phishing-as-a-service toolkit has integrated device code phishing capabilities to circumvent multi-factor authentication protections and compromise user accounts. This technique exploits the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant specification and represents a growing threat vector in commercial crimeware.

cybersecurity.title: Fake Adobe and Zoom Updates Install ScreenConnect for Persistent Remote Access
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers disclosed a multi-wave social engineering campaign, codenamed SMOKE#SCREEN, that uses fraudulent Adobe and Zoom update prompts to deploy ConnectWise ScreenConnect remote management tools for persistent network access. The campaign employs diverse lures including business document reviews and system maintenance themes.

cybersecurity.title: New cPanel Critical Flaw Could Let Hosting Customers Run SQL as Database Root
cybersecurity.summary: cPanel patched a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-58048, CVSS 9.4) allowing authenticated hosting customers to execute SQL commands with database root privileges, effectively bypassing privilege boundaries between customer accounts and server administrative databases. The patch addressed this flaw alongside two other privilege escalation routes.

cybersecurity.title: DOUBLECUP Uses ClickFix and Cached PNGs to Deliver CountLoader and DeviceManager RAT
cybersecurity.summary: A Russian loader-as-a-service platform named DOUBLECUP employs ClickFix social engineering lures to stage malware-infected PNG images in browser caches, leading to deployment of the CountLoader malware and a previously undocumented remote access trojan called DeviceManager. The multi-stage attack hides malicious payloads using steganography.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Seizes NetNut Proxy Platform, Popa Botnet
cybersecurity.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation coordinated with industry partners to seize hundreds of domains associated with NetNut, a residential proxy service operated by Israeli firm Alarum Technologies, following security researchers' findings linking the platform to the Popa botnet comprising at least two million compromised devices. The action addresses criminal abuse of legitimate proxy infrastructure.

cybersecurity.title: When Vibe Hacking Turns AI into the Junior Hacker Every Adversary Always Wanted
cybersecurity.summary: Security researchers examine how artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing the relationship between attacker sophistication and offensive capability, potentially enabling less technically skilled actors to execute complex attacks. The analysis challenges longstanding cybersecurity industry assumptions about the correlation between expertise and attack effectiveness.

cybersecurity.title: Google Deletes 3 ADK AI Workflows After Malicious GitHub Issue Could Trigger Privileged Agent
cybersecurity.summary: Google removed three AI agent workflows from its Agent Development Kit repository after Pillar Security demonstrated that a public GitHub issue could prompt-inject a triage agent into executing a privileged code-fixing agent. The vulnerability illustrates risks associated with inter-agent communication in autonomous AI systems.

startups-vc.title: A Record 14 Billion-Dollar Rounds In July Pushed Venture's Historic Run Higher
startups-vc.summary: Global venture funding reached $65 billion in July 2026, representing 100% year-over-year growth and marking the highest-ever number of billion-dollar venture rounds on record. The data from Crunchbase demonstrates continued momentum in the venture capital ecosystem despite broader economic uncertainties.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Safe Superintelligence And Commonwealth Fusion Lead With Billion-Dollar Deals
startups-vc.summary: Safe Superintelligence raised $5 billion in Nvidia-backed financing to lead the week's largest funding rounds, while Commonwealth Fusion Systems secured $1 billion in investment. The mega-rounds underscore continued investor confidence in AI and advanced technology infrastructure sectors.

startups-vc.title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
startups-vc.summary: Italian software company Bending Spoons has agreed to acquire productivity platform Airtable for $1.28 billion, representing a significant down round from its $11 billion peak valuation in 2021. The acquisition reflects the current valuation corrections in the startup market following the earlier venture boom.

startups-vc.title: Freehand Raises $75M Series B To Automate Fortune 500 Supply Chain Spend
startups-vc.summary: Freehand, an enterprise platform providing autonomous AI agents for supply chain and back-office operations management, has secured $75 million in Series B funding. The round demonstrates investor appetite for AI-powered enterprise automation solutions targeting high-value operational spending.

startups-vc.title: 'A Rare Land-Grab Moment': Menlo Ventures' Matt Murphy On The Next Wave of AI And Putting $3B In New Capital To Work
startups-vc.summary: Menlo Ventures partner Matt Murphy discusses the firm's $3 billion in new capital dedicated to AI investments and explains how lessons from its Anthropic relationship are shaping larger deal strategies. The interview reveals how top-tier VCs are repositioning portfolios around AI opportunities at scale.

startups-vc.title: Exclusive: Former Meta And Slack Engineers Raise $15M For New Startup Centralize To Build A 'Deal GPS' For Enterprise Sales
startups-vc.summary: Centralize, an enterprise sales platform founded by former Meta and Slack engineers, has emerged from stealth with $15 million in Series A funding to automate deal management workflows. The startup targets the quote-to-cash segment with AI-powered tools for sales teams.

startups-vc.title: 5 Interesting Learnings from Palantir at $7.7 Billion ARR: 93% Growth (!), 157% NRR, and a Rule of 40 Score of 155%
startups-vc.summary: Palantir Technologies achieved 93% year-over-year revenue growth to $1.935 billion ARR with a record Rule of 40 score of 155%, demonstrating that growth deceleration need not be inevitable at enterprise scale. The company's twelve consecutive quarters of accelerating growth and 47% GAAP operating margins set a notable benchmark in the SaaS industry.

startups-vc.title: These Are Sectors Where Seed Rounds Of $5M To $10M Are Clustering This Year
startups-vc.summary: Analysis of 2026 seed funding patterns reveals clustering of $5-10 million rounds in high-growth sectors including cancer therapeutics and space technology. The data provides strategic insights into where early-stage investors are concentrating capital and which verticals attract institutional-scale seed funding.

startups-vc.title: The Sweet Science: Why The AI Era Belongs To Middleweights
startups-vc.summary: FTV Capital managing partner Brad Bernstein argues that middleweight technology companies—rather than heavyweight incumbents or AI-native startups—are positioned to capture the largest long-term gains from AI adoption. The column identifies five key traits that characterize successful middle-market technology companies in the AI era.

startups-vc.title: 2026 Is The Biggest IPO Year In History. But Take Out SpaceX And Right Now It's One of the Worst.
startups-vc.summary: While 2026 has generated $1.786 trillion in US venture-backed IPO value through July, excluding SpaceX the year represents one of the weakest periods for public market exits in recent history. The data reveals significant concentration of exit value in a handful of mega-deals and declining IPO performance for SaaS companies.

energy-climate.title: Q&A: What does China's 15th 'five-year plan' for renewables mean for climate change?
energy-climate.summary: China has released its 15th five-year plan for renewable energy development, outlining key targets and policies that will significantly shape global climate trajectories. The plan's implications extend beyond China's domestic energy transition to influence worldwide renewable energy markets and climate commitments.

energy-climate.title: Factcheck: How nuclear, gas, wind and solar power are affected during heatwaves
energy-climate.summary: As heatwaves intensify due to climate change, energy infrastructure faces mounting operational challenges across multiple generation sources globally. The analysis examines vulnerability patterns in nuclear, gas, wind, and solar power systems during extreme heat events.

energy-climate.title: Clean energy offers least-cost path to meeting US electricity demand
energy-climate.summary: A new study demonstrates that pursuing a clean energy pathway to meet U.S. electricity demand by 2030 would cost $5 billion less than relying on fossil fuels. The analysis strengthens the economic case for renewable energy transition in North America's largest economy.

energy-climate.title: Distributed solar supplied 27% of Pakistan's electricity in 2025
energy-climate.summary: Analysis by the Pakistan Solar Association reveals that distributed rooftop and off-grid solar systems supplied approximately 27% of the nation's electricity in 2025, a figure significantly underrepresented in official grid statistics. The rapid proliferation of unmonitored solar generation is creating network design challenges for Pakistan's power infrastructure.

energy-climate.title: Photovoltaics feed record 12 TWh into Germany's public grid in July
energy-climate.summary: Germany's solar installations delivered a record 12 TWh to the public grid in July 2026, surpassing the previous monthly high set in June. The milestone underscores Germany's advancing renewable energy penetration and the growing role of solar in Europe's energy transition.

energy-climate.title: Avaada secures $1.3bn in financing for 2.15GW renewable energy projects
energy-climate.summary: Avaada Group has closed $1.3 billion in financing to support a portfolio of renewable energy projects totaling 2.15 GW of capacity. The major funding round demonstrates robust investment momentum in large-scale renewable energy development.

energy-climate.title: China draws a line under the solar price war
energy-climate.summary: Chinese regulators are urging domestic solar manufacturers to cease destructive below-cost competition, though formal price floor mechanisms have not yet been imposed. The intervention signals Beijing's intent to stabilize the solar market while preserving industry viability.

energy-climate.title: Australia's remote mining companies turn to renewable hybrid power systems
energy-climate.summary: Australian mining operations in remote locations are adopting renewable hybrid power systems, with operational data showing multiple off-grid industrial sites consistently operating at renewable penetration rates exceeding 80%. These installations demonstrate the technical feasibility of high-renewable systems for heavy industrial applications.

energy-climate.title: Antora raises $550m to deploy large-scale thermal storage in US
energy-climate.summary: Antora Energy has secured $550 million in Series C funding to accelerate deployment of large-scale thermal battery storage solutions across the United States. The investment underscores growing market confidence in thermal energy storage as a critical enabling technology for grid decarbonization.

energy-climate.title: Sonnedix secures $841m for renewable projects in southern Europe
energy-climate.summary: Sonnedix has secured €730 million in financing to support refinancing, optimization, and development of renewable energy assets across Italy, Spain, Portugal, and France. The capital infusion strengthens renewable energy expansion in southern Europe's key markets.

asia-pacific.title: Japan's 2026 Defense White Paper Warns of China's Expanding Military Reach in the Pacific
asia-pacific.summary: Japan's latest defense white paper emphasizes Beijing's growing capability to project military power beyond the First Island Chain, signaling heightened regional security concerns. The assessment reflects Japan's strategic reassessment of China's expanding military footprint across the Asia-Pacific region.

asia-pacific.title: What Philippine President Marcos Said About China in His State of the Nation Address
asia-pacific.summary: Philippine President Marcos addressed China-related concerns in his state of the nation address, with his rhetoric carrying added significance following recent maritime clashes between Chinese and Philippine vessels in the South China Sea. The statement reflects ongoing tensions in the disputed waterway.

asia-pacific.title: Are Indonesia's Prabowo and ultra rich '9 Dragons' on a collision course?
asia-pacific.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's push for a stronger, more interventionist state is increasingly at odds with the country's wealthiest tycoon families, known as the 'Nine Dragons,' who dominate banking, tobacco, property, and natural resources sectors. The potential conflict could reshape Indonesia's economic governance and business landscape.

asia-pacific.title: Why China's military is laser-focused on 'disruptive' technologies
asia-pacific.summary: As the People's Liberation Army approaches its centenary milestone, China's military strategy increasingly emphasizes asymmetric technological development rather than matching US capabilities weapon-for-weapon. The focus on emerging and disruptive technologies reflects Beijing's long-term strategic approach to maintaining military competitiveness.

asia-pacific.title: Why China's new sovereign bond sale in Hong Kong is drawing global interest
asia-pacific.summary: China's Ministry of Finance is conducting a 15 billion yuan sovereign bond auction in Hong Kong, marking the fourth tranche of Beijing's annual 84 billion yuan bond program and tapping international capital markets. The sale reflects China's efforts to attract global investors following Hong Kong's introduction of new hedging tools for mainland bonds.

asia-pacific.title: Donald Trump's Tariff Re-Do in Southeast Asia
asia-pacific.summary: The Trump administration's tariff policies are creating uncertainty and concern among Southeast Asian partners and allies, threatening to undermine Washington's long-term regional standing through inconsistent and capricious treatment. The approach risks damaging diplomatic relationships across the strategically important region.

asia-pacific.title: Indian ship sinks in Red Sea after attack near Yemen
asia-pacific.summary: An Indian-flagged commercial vessel sank in the Red Sea following an attack attributed to Iran-backed Houthi rebels, with the crew rescued but India condemning the aggression. The incident reflects escalating maritime security threats in a critical shipping corridor affecting Asia-Pacific trade.

asia-pacific.title: It's Time for the East Asia Summit to Tackle Nuclear Proliferation
asia-pacific.summary: As regional countries increasingly consider nuclear weapons acquisition, the East Asia Summit should take a leading role in addressing the growing challenges of nuclear proliferation in Asia-Pacific. The proposal reflects growing concerns about weapons acquisition trends among regional powers.

asia-pacific.title: Iran in Port Sudan? The Next Threat to Asian Markets
asia-pacific.summary: Iran's potential involvement in Port Sudan presents an emerging security threat to critical Asian trade routes, yet remains largely overlooked in regional security assessments. The development could significantly impact the Red Sea corridor upon which Asia-Pacific commerce depends.

asia-pacific.title: As World Bank Retreats From Climate Targets, India's Most Vulnerable Could Pay the Price
asia-pacific.summary: The World Bank's retreat from climate financing targets threatens to reduce funding for climate adaptation infrastructure in India's most vulnerable communities. The shortfall particularly impacts grassroots climate resilience projects in rural villages struggling to secure necessary capital for survival and livelihood protection.
